note: Incumbent Democrat Katie Hobbs seeks a second term; no U.S. Senate seat is up in Arizona in 2026.

cands.name: Katie Hobbs
cands.desc: First-term governor and former Secretary of State; set a state record for vetoes against the Republican-led Legislature; unopposed in the Democratic primary.

cands.name: Andy Biggs
cands.desc: U.S. Representative (AZ-5) since 2017 and former Arizona Senate president; former House Freedom Caucus chair; endorsed by President Trump; won the July 21 GOP primary with about 74%.
